title: MissionForge flight phases
description: The flight phases of design section 9.1. Phase IDs (F0 to F14, F7b) share the letter F with fact IDs (F01 to F40): a phase ID only ever appears in a field named phase, parallel_with or flight_phases, a fact ID in a field named facts.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

phase.description: Unique flight-phase ID (not a fact ID).

name_key.description: String key of the phase name.

parallel_with.description: Flight phase this one runs alongside as a parallel track (F7b runs alongside F7).

second_pilot.description: True if a second pilot flies this phase in split screen.

pilot_actions_key.description: String key of the Pilot actions column. Omit when the design shows a dash.

console_duties_key.description: String key of the Console duties column. Omit when the design shows a dash.

console_roles.description: Roles the Console duties column names.

all_consoles.description: True if the Console duties column addresses every console.

phones_show_static.description: True if non-pilot phones show static during the phase (plasma blackout).

minigames.description: Minigames that can occur in the phase: the Minigames column plus the minigames whose When line in design section 10.5 names the phase. Conditions are in the triggers of data/minigames.json.

possible_events.description: The Possible events column, one entry per event.

id.description: Event ID, unique within the file. Minigame triggers of kind event use the same IDs.

name_key.description: String key of the event as printed.

failure_mode.description: Failure mode of design section 8.4 that produces the event, where one matches.

abort_mode.description: Abort mode of data/abort_modes.json the event leads to, where the design names one.

fact_moment_key.description: String key of the Fact moment column.

facts.description: Fact-bank IDs (F01 to F40, not flight phases) that state the same fact as the Fact moment column.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.
